review_scope: Fresh-context review of the revised FRT and TR-PVQ candidates plus historical STRC. No model, experiment, cluster job or heavy I/O was run. Candidate directories were not modified.

workflow.simplification: Coherence, critique and implementability were combined as permitted for this ResearchStudio-Idea review; this is not a canonical pipeline DONE claim.
workflow.evidence_boundary: Local audits and saved primary-source records were read. No new empirical support is claimed. Existing DINO W4/W8 evidence is fake/numerical unless a native backend is separately measured.

candidate_reviews.name: Signed Temporal Residual Calibration / Temporal Residual Feedback Calibration (historical)
candidate_reviews.artifact_status: rejected_attempt; retained only as history and not used to inherit novelty
candidate_reviews.rationale: K_r is association rather than causal transfer, squared lag covariance loses sign, A(q) and A_pi(q) use different treatment paths, and gamma=1 can telescope transition increments to ordinary terminal drift. A single-site score relabeled as temporal, fake logical bytes, or an observer cannot repair the estimand.
blocking_findings: K_r(ell)=E[e_(t+ell) r_t^T] confounds initial state, phase, action magnitude, shared randomness and policy feedback.
sum_l ||K_r(l)||^2 cannot support signed cancellation language.
Natural q-versus-FP drift and FP-path shuffled residual injection are not matched interventions.
Transition-increment e with gamma=1 reduces to terminal displacement.
Conditional swaps must not be interpreted as novelty if interaction is zero or scores are additive single-site rankings.

near_neighbor_status.DA-PTQ: virtual Jacobian, trajectory motion surrogate and mixed precision already cover broad drift-aware allocation
near_neighbor_status.QuantWAMs: reachable-state/Fisher calibration and schedule repair already cover structural closed-loop WAM calibration
near_neighbor_status.Feedback_World_Model: online transition-residual observer covers deployment feedback
near_neighbor_status.RPIQ: retrieved abstract warns of residual accumulation, Gauss-Seidel closed-loop quantization and compensation; exact overlap unresolved
near_neighbor_status.status: load-bearing mismatch; do not advance or call it a local revise

candidate_reviews.salvage_boundary: FRT is a new candidate. It must be independently judged against QDrop/noisy-input, directional sensitivity and stale-residual controls.
no_go_conditions: Any use of squared K_r as signed-cancellation evidence
Physical/transition residual semantics remain undefined or gamma=1 is ordinary terminal drift
The claimed mechanism is only single-site/additive score ranking or deployment observer/error feedback

candidate_reviews.name: Frozen-Residual Transport PTQ (FRT)
candidate_reviews.artifact_status: conditional candidate in IDEA.zh.md and phase2_generate/frozen_residual_transport_ptq.json; reviewed as new mechanism after STRC abandonment
candidate_reviews.novelty_status: conditional domain-specific pilot hypothesis; generic sensitivity novelty is not claimed
candidate_reviews.rationale: FRT is coherent enough for a bounded pilot: a fixed Q0 W4 map produces a paired residual delta, delta is inserted only into the next predicted latent slot, and a quantized one-step finite-difference transport is matched to FP while bits and deployment state stay fixed. The central difference remains conditional because this is a local directional-response objective adjacent to QDrop, PD-Quant, Sobolev/JVP/GAD and direct two-step matching.

load_bearing_definition: delta_Q0=stopgrad(F_Q0(X,a)-F_FP(X,a)) from the same history/action/RNG pair
delta_Q0 is placed in the newly predicted latent slot; older history slots and cache fields stay unchanged
T_theta=F_theta(x+delta_Q0,a')-F_theta(x,a') is matched to T_FP with the same x, delta_Q0 and a'
L_FRT is clean latent reconstruction plus lambda_T transport mismatch under frozen latent scale W_z
Physical xy is an independent held-out environment closed-loop endpoint, not a latent-to-xy linear readout
mechanism_audit.coherence_status: coherent finite-difference transport hypothesis, subject to hard-W4 and full-history interface gates
strengths: Removes STRC's K/sign/phase/causal problems and does not add observer or online correction.
Q0-derived direction is quantization-specific in construction and is tested against a same-norm random direction.
Fixed W4 map and no bit allocator make the deployment boundary auditable.
Fresh Q0 and one-time fresh Q_theta residual checks give a direct anti-self-reconstruction test.

generic_sensitivity_risk.finding: The transport contrast can be a named version of directional/Jacobian sensitivity matching.
generic_sensitivity_risk.required_test: The primary pilot control is random same-norm delta with exactly the same finite-difference target structure, optimizer, W4 parameter freedom, CAL/DEV budget and endpoint. An explicit JVP or multi-direction finite-difference control is a useful diagnostic, not a mandatory full-pilot gate. If the Q0 direction is equivalent on fresh DEV and held-out closed-loop endpoint, abandon FRT novelty and the candidate.

frozen_direction_risk.finding: Fitting Q_theta can change the deployed residual direction away from frozen delta_Q0.
frozen_direction_risk.required_test: On DEV, collect one fresh Q_theta residual without refitting and report norm, cosine/alignment and transport ranking against delta_Q0. If the direction is stale and fresh-Q0 transport does not transfer, classify as Q0-proximal overfit and abandon.

required_definition: Write exact signed W4 q_min/q_max and per-output-channel scale axis for Q0 and Q_theta.
Freeze scale convention, zero/tie rounding, clamp order and treatment of exact integer boundaries.
Use soft h(alpha) only during CAL; hard-freeze h(alpha) to {0,1}, discard alpha and re-evaluate the materialized checkpoint on DEV/TEST.
State whether scale, codebook/metadata and packing overhead count toward actual-byte ceiling; logical bytes must be kept separate from packed bytes.
hard_w4_math_gate.current_equation: q_int,g=clip(floor(w_g/s_g)+h(alpha_g),q_min,q_max), h(alpha_g) in [0,1] during CAL and h(alpha_g) in {0,1} after hardening; w_hat_g=s_g*q_int,g.
hard_w4_math_gate.failure: STE/soft values, unspecified W4 range or logical-byte arithmetic cannot support a hard-W4 deployment claim.

required_definition: Exact full-history schema and slot ordering
Real shift/concat operation and newly predicted slot shape
Normalization, cache/history fields, action/chunk alignment and RNG replay
Proof that x+delta is a legal runner input and that T_FP/T_theta use the same current state and next action
history_slot_gate.failure: Broadcasting delta across history, dropping cache fields or using an off-manifold input makes the score an interface artifact; stop the candidate.

single_site_subsumption_audit.status: lower risk than STRC; interaction is not load-bearing
single_site_subsumption_audit.finding: No additive site score or bit allocator is proposed, but AdaRound-style scalar/rounding fitting can still look like local PTQ with a transport label.
single_site_subsumption_audit.required_test: At matched W4 bytes compare clean-only, direct two-step, QDrop/noise, random-delta and FRT fits using the same target map and endpoint. Joint-versus-independent fitting may be reported descriptively, but near-zero interaction alone is not a FRT no-go.

near_neighbor_audit.name: QDrop
near_neighbor_audit.mechanism: Randomly drops activation quantization during PTQ reconstruction to improve robustness/flatness.
near_neighbor_audit.required_difference: FRT must beat the exact matched random/noisy-input control through fresh Q0 direction and downstream endpoint; otherwise it is QDrop-like robustness fitting.

near_neighbor_audit.name: AdaRound
near_neighbor_audit.mechanism: Data/task-aware layer-local rounding optimization with soft relaxation and hard materialization.
near_neighbor_audit.required_difference: AdaRound supplies a possible hard-rounding implementation; only Q0 residual transport can differentiate the objective.

near_neighbor_audit.name: PD-Quant
near_neighbor_audit.mechanism: Global FP/Q prediction difference with regularization and activation-distribution correction.
near_neighbor_audit.required_difference: FRT must show a transport-of-x+delta gain beyond clean/global prediction difference and must validate on fresh residuals.

near_neighbor_audit.name: Sobolev Training
near_neighbor_audit.mechanism: Derivative matching to preserve local function behavior in training/distillation/compression settings.
near_neighbor_audit.required_difference: No first sensitivity/Jacobian claim; JVP/multi-direction is optional diagnostic and Q0-specific direction is the only conditional narrowing.

near_neighbor_audit.name: GAD
near_neighbor_audit.mechanism: JVP-based initial-noise sensitivity alignment in a distillation/training setting.
near_neighbor_audit.required_difference: The same-structure random same-norm delta control must separate Q0-induced direction from generic sensitivity alignment.

near_neighbor_audit.name: DA-PTQ
near_neighbor_audit.mechanism: Virtual Jacobian, trajectory-level motion surrogate, cross-space compensation and mixed precision.
near_neighbor_audit.required_difference: FRT remains fixed-bit, no compensation and uses finite-difference transport of Q0 residuals; generic Jacobian/motion allocation is covered.

near_neighbor_audit.name: QuantWAMs
near_neighbor_audit.mechanism: Shared-basis/Fisher/reachable-state calibration and denoising schedule repair for WAMs.
near_neighbor_audit.required_difference: FRT uses no Fisher allocator, schedule repair or shared-basis claim; DINO-WM pilot has no denoising schedule.

near_neighbor_audit.name: Feedback World Model
near_neighbor_audit.mechanism: Online transition-residual observer and action-aware latent feedback.
near_neighbor_audit.required_difference: FRT remains offline calibration with no observer, online correction or deployment-time FP reference.

near_neighbor_audit.name: RPIQ
near_neighbor_audit.mechanism: Retrieved abstract reports residual accumulation, Gauss-Seidel closed-loop/single-instance quantization and residual-projected compensation; full objective was not verified here.
near_neighbor_audit.required_difference: FRT must not implement residual compensation or error-feedback arithmetic; broad residual/closed-loop novelty remains unresolved until full method is checked.

required_gates: Light interface gate before GPU time
Fresh Q0 and fresh Q_theta residual transfer checks
Held-out environment closed-loop physical xy endpoint with disjoint episode/initial-state split
no_go_conditions: Full-history contract or one-step map cannot be restored
Hard W4 range/rounding/packing definition is missing
Random same-norm control matches FRT on fresh DEV and downstream endpoint
FRT only improves CAL, or final Q_theta residual is badly misaligned with frozen Q0 without a scoped explanation
The effect is explained by clean-MSE/parameter freedom or an online observer/error-feedback path

feasibility_4xa100.evidence: Existing audit reports DINO-WM Wall CEM about 4.06 GiB and a probe around 12,820 MB sampled device memory; this supports an inference-only bounded screen, not unmeasured backward or native runtime.
feasibility_4xa100.a100_40gb: Plausible for the first screen, runtime unmeasured.
feasibility_4xa100.a100_80gb: Headroom only; not a fallback to exceed the planning cap.
feasibility_4xa100.planning_cap: <=12 A100 GPU-hours including baselines/startup/failure is a planning stop, not a measurement or statistical guarantee.
feasibility_4xa100.allocation: All model loading, heavy I/O and computation require real PBS_JOBID, non-login hostname and confirmed GPU allocation; no login-node fallback.

candidate_reviews.name: Trajectory-Relational Product VQ (TR-PVQ)
candidate_reviews.artifact_status: STATUS.zh.md plus REVISION_RESPONSE.zh.md and Phase 1/selection artifacts; no completed canonical phase2_generate artifact
candidate_reviews.novelty_status: conditional controlled domain adaptation; no general relational-VQ novelty claim
candidate_reviews.rationale: The revision correctly makes the relation depend on quantized-model imagined trajectories, adds a goal/absolute anchor, removes Gram diagonal from the main relation loss, fixes an actual-byte ceiling and removes rate allocation/schedule/accelerator claims. However, pairwise relational objectives already have RKD and CR-QAT collision families, while VPTQ/AQLM/RSAVQ/MotionVQ/DA-PTQ/QuantWAMs/Feedback World Model cover adjacent quantization, geometry, motion and feedback mechanisms. The candidate is a pilot hypothesis, not an authenticated new principle.

mechanism_audit.current_objective: L_TR=L_abs+lambda_rel L_off, where trajectories are rerun by each quantized model, goal anchor is frozen in source output coordinates, and L_off uses off-diagonal pairwise Gram terms.
strengths: No longer a fixed-input Gram that is independent of codebook/index.
Absolute/planner score anchor addresses harmful rotation/translation and diagonal-as-goal-score issues.
Actual-byte ceiling, fixed group map and no rate allocator reduce confounding with RSAVQ/MotionVQ.
The proposed codebook-only bounded first update is cheaper than unrestricted vector search.

blocking_findings.finding: Relational pairwise fitting is not novel in the abstract.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Treat RKD and CR-QAT as direct collision families and narrow the claim to fixed-byte DINO-WM weight VQ only after a source-complete comparison.

blocking_findings.finding: The relation term may be a post-hoc report if it does not change codebook/index choices.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Show L_TR changes codebook/index map and beats L_abs/local-MSE/VPTQ-like at matched actual bytes; otherwise classify as ablation/negative result.

blocking_findings.finding: Fixed group map, pooling, horizon, normalization and CEM objective can silently define the result.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Freeze and publish these before TEST; keep action neighborhood, first action and return/success as held-out endpoints.

blocking_findings.finding: Packed VPTQ/AQLM layout is not native DINO-WM evidence.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Report logical bits, actual codebook/index/scale/metadata bytes, packed loader, Peak VRAM and synchronized throughput separately.

near_neighbor_audit.name: Relational Knowledge Distillation
near_neighbor_audit.mechanism: Transfers pairwise distance and angle relations among examples.
near_neighbor_audit.required_difference: TR-PVQ must show that quantized DINO-WM imagined-trajectory relations select a better fixed-byte weight codebook, rather than restating relational representation matching.

near_neighbor_audit.name: CR-QAT
near_neighbor_audit.mechanism: Retrieved record reports text-anchored pairwise similarity combined with QAT for open-vocabulary object detection.
near_neighbor_audit.required_difference: TR-PVQ must distinguish fixed-byte weight VQ on WM imagined trajectories from text-anchored pairwise similarity/QAT; no broad pairwise-quantization novelty claim.
near_neighbor_audit.status: direct adjacent collision; source-complete method comparison required

near_neighbor_audit.name: VPTQ
near_neighbor_audit.mechanism: Second-order/channel-independent vector PTQ with codebook/index and residual/outlier storage.
near_neighbor_audit.required_difference: Only a quantized-model-dependent imagined-trajectory relation objective can separate TR-PVQ; packed lookup is inherited.

near_neighbor_audit.name: AQLM
near_neighbor_audit.mechanism: Additive multi-codebook block quantization with calibration outputs and practical kernels.
near_neighbor_audit.required_difference: TR-PVQ must show relation-driven codebook selection beyond calibration-output fitting and separately measure its packed path.

near_neighbor_audit.name: RSAVQ
near_neighbor_audit.mechanism: FIM/Riemannian error-direction guidance and channel sensitivity allocation.
near_neighbor_audit.required_difference: TR-PVQ must keep fixed bytes/groups and avoid Fisher/natural-gradient/rate allocation claims.

near_neighbor_audit.name: MotionVQ/VQVLA
near_neighbor_audit.mechanism: Motion-aware dynamic precision, centroid reuse and custom accelerator path.
near_neighbor_audit.required_difference: TR-PVQ must remain static relation-driven weight VQ without dynamic schedule or accelerator claim.

near_neighbor_audit.name: DA-PTQ
near_neighbor_audit.mechanism: Virtual Jacobian, trajectory motion surrogate and mixed precision.
near_neighbor_audit.required_difference: Relation codebook fitting must not be relabeled Jacobian/motion allocation.

near_neighbor_audit.name: QuantWAMs
near_neighbor_audit.mechanism: Joint video-action Fisher/reachable-state calibration and schedule repair.
near_neighbor_audit.required_difference: TR-PVQ must compress weights using relation fitting, not schedule/Fisher auditing.

near_neighbor_audit.name: Feedback World Model
near_neighbor_audit.mechanism: Online transition-residual observer and action-aware latent feedback.
near_neighbor_audit.required_difference: TR-PVQ must not introduce online observer or residual correction.

required_gates: Freeze source output coordinate, goal anchor, pooling, horizon, action probes and CEM objective.
Use the same actual-byte ceiling and report overhead/slack for every variant.
Compare FP32, VPTQ-like/local-MSE, L_abs, L_TR, scalar, independent-codebook, shuffled-pair and same-byte random/index controls.
Show held-out off-diagonal relation, planner first action, action neighborhood and return/success together.
no_go_conditions: Relation is fixed-input or does not change codebook/index choices
L_TR map equals L_abs/local-MSE/VPTQ-like and relation is only a post-hoc report
Pair-label shuffle or scalar/independent-codebook matches the relation gain
RKD/CR-QAT or another exact relational/task-aware VQ source subsumes the objective
Native compression/latency is claimed from logical bits, fake quantization or inherited layout

feasibility_4xa100.evidence: Existing DINO-WM Wall audit supports a single-card inference screen but not the candidate-specific imagined-trajectory/codebook search or native kernel.
feasibility_4xa100.a100_40gb: Plausible for a tiny codebook identity/held-out relation gate; full search runtime unmeasured.
feasibility_4xa100.a100_80gb: Headroom only and must be reported separately.
feasibility_4xa100.planning_cap: Approximately 8-16 allocated A100-hours is a planning estimate, not measured runtime; stop at the declared cap.
feasibility_4xa100.allocation: Model loading, codebook search, hashing, I/O and timing require real PBS allocation with PBS_JOBID, non-login hostname and GPU checks.

cross_branch_decision.non_vq: abandon STRC; revise FRT as a new mechanism and prioritize its bounded pilot
cross_branch_decision.vq: revise TR-PVQ only as a conditional fixed-byte WM hypothesis; no general relational-VQ novelty claim
cross_branch_decision.priority: FRT first because its mechanism and stop rule are narrower and its first screen does not require a new codebook/kernel path.
cross_branch_decision.release_gate: Do not advance either candidate until its stated matched controls and no-go checks pass; do not keep an idea solely to deliver two.

feasibility_summary.dino_anchor: Existing DINO-WM Wall CEM is about 4.06 GiB with a calibration probe around 12,820 MB sampled device memory; this supports inference-only planning evidence only.
feasibility_summary.4xa100: Four A100s are a concurrency ceiling, not proof that full-model replicas, backward passes, long rollouts or exhaustive maps fit.
feasibility_summary.native_boundary: Logical/fake W4 or VQ results do not imply packed checkpoint bytes, Peak VRAM, synchronized throughput or latency without an actual backend and same-workload FP/BF16 reference.
feasibility_summary.cluster_boundary: All future heavy I/O, model loading and compute must run under a real PBS allocation on a non-login hostname with nonempty PBS_JOBID and confirmed GPU allocation; login node remains lightweight control only.
